title: Classic Korean-Style Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on traditional lamb kebabs, inspired by Korean barbecue. Marinated in a sweet and savory blend of soy sauce, garlic, and ginger.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder or leg, cut into 1-inch cubes
Gochujang (Korean chili paste)
ingredients.notes: Adjust to taste for desired spiciness

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Mince to release oils for better flavor

ingredients.name: Rice vinegar
ingredients.notes: Helps balance acidity and adds depth

ingredients.name: Green onions, chopped (optional)
ingredients.notes: Garnish or add to kebabs for extra flavor

instructions: 1. In a small bowl, whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, and rice vinegar to make the marinade.
2. Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix until they are evenly coated.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight, up to 24 hours.
4. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
5. Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
7. Transfer the kebabs to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
8. Garnish with chopped green onions, if desired.
